title: For each year between 2011 and 2013, compute the total gas consumption by c
question: For each year between 2011 and 2013, compute the total gas consumption by customers who paid in CZK, but only include consumption from customers whose segment matches the most common customer segment among all CZK-paying customers in that year.

prediction.sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) AS year,
        y.XCL_021 AS consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2012', '2013')
),
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        segment,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, segment ASC) AS rn
    FROM czk_customers
    GROUP BY year, segment
),
most_common_segments AS (
    SELECT year, segment
    FROM segment_counts
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    cc.year,
    SUM(cc.consumption) AS total_gas_consumption
FROM czk_customers cc
INNER JOIN most_common_segments mcs 
    ON cc.year = mcs.year AND cc.segment = mcs.segment
GROUP BY cc.year
ORDER BY cc.year

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) AS year,
        y.XCL_021 AS consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2012', '2013')
),
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        segment,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, segment ASC) AS rn
    FROM czk_customers
    GROUP BY year, segment
),
most_common_segments AS (
    SELECT year, segment
    FROM segment_counts
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    cc.year,
    SUM(cc.consumption) AS total_gas_consumption
FROM czk_customers cc
INNER JOIN most_common_segments mcs 
    ON cc.year = mcs.year AND cc.segment = mcs.segment
GROUP BY cc.year
ORDER BY cc.year

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) AS year,
        y.XCL_021 AS consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2012', '2013')
),
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        segment,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, segment ASC) AS rn
    FROM czk_customers
    GROUP BY year, segment
),
most_common_segments AS (
    SELECT year, segment
    FROM segment_counts
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    cc.year,
    SUM(cc.consumption) AS total_gas_consumption
FROM czk_customers cc
INNER JOIN most_common_segments mcs 
    ON cc.year = mcs.year AND cc.segment = mcs.segment
GROUP BY cc.year
ORDER BY cc.year

WITH czk_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        t.XCL_014 AS product_id,
        t.XCL_018 AS amount,
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) BETWEEN '2011' AND '2013'
),
segment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.year,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM czk_customers cc
    JOIN customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
    GROUP BY cc.year, c.XCL_002
),
most_common_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        segment
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            year,
            segment,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
        FROM segment_counts
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    cc.year,
    SUM(cc.amount) AS total_gas_consumption
FROM czk_customers cc
JOIN customers c ON cc.customer_id = c.XCL_001
JOIN most_common_segments mcs ON cc.year = mcs.year AND c.XCL_002 = mcs.segment
GROUP BY cc.year
ORDER BY cc.year
